name: Salesforce Claude Code
description: SCC (scc-universal on npm) is a Claude Code plugin that supercharges your Salesforce development workflow with 17 expert subagents, 55 domain knowledge skills, and 29 automated quality gates. Built for Apex, LWC, SOQL, Flow, Visualforce, Aura, DevOps, and Agentforce — covering every layer of the Salesforce platform.
longDescription:
Ships **58 skills**, **17 agents**, **7 hooks** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (58): `aside` (Use when you need a quick Salesforce answer mid-task), `checkpoint` (Use when saving Salesforce development progress), `configure-scc` (Use when setting up SCC for Salesforce Apex and LWC development), `continuous-agent-loop` (Use when building autonomous Claude Code loops for Salesforce Apex and LWC projects), `mcp-server-patterns` (Use when building MCP servers for Salesforce Apex or org integration), `model-route` (Use when selecting Claude model tier for Salesforce development tasks), `prompt-optimizer` (Use when improving a Salesforce, Apex, or LWC prompt), `refactor-clean` (Use when cleaning up Salesforce Apex or LWC code), and 50 more
- **Agents** (17): `deep-researcher` (Multi-source Salesforce research — Apex patterns, org architecture, platform event trade-offs, deploy strategies), `doc-updater` (Sync Salesforce project docs with codebase — codemaps, ADRs, data dictionaries, deployment runbooks, ApexDoc), `eval-runner` (Run eval suites for Salesforce Apex and org quality — define pass/fail, grade with code/model graders, run pipeline…), `learning-engine` (Build learning loops for Salesforce Apex and org development — observe patterns, create confidence-scored instincts, feed insights to…), `loop-operator` (Run autonomous loops over Salesforce tasks — iterating Apex refactors, test coverage improvements, deploy validations, or multi-agent pipeline…), `refactor-cleaner` (Use when removing dead Apex code, unused metadata, or duplicate logic from a Salesforce project using PMD with…), `sf-admin-agent` (Configure Salesforce org — objects, fields, relationships, permissions, sharing, Custom Metadata, Experience Cloud), `sf-agentforce-agent` (Build and test Agentforce AI agents — Agent Script, topics, Apex actions, metadata deployment), and 9 more
- **Hooks** (7): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `PreCompact`, `Stop`, `SessionEnd`
- **MCP servers** (2): `salesforce-dx`, `salesforce-cli`

Installs with `claude plugin install salesforce-claude-code@claude-community` from `jiten-singh-shahi/salesforce-claude-code`.
